fusions.name: Passed Blame
fusions.desc: Flings a weighted link that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each enemy hit has a 25% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Tied Bootlaces
fusions.desc: Knots together the feet of every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Links
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tethered Prey
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you deal 25% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
